title: 第13章 那小子是谁？第14章 欢呼吧！混蛋们！
content_zh:
第十三章 那小子是谁?
蓝色意大利球场，亚特兰大足球队的主场所在地，可以同时容纳两万五千多人，以往这里的上座率并不高，原因嘛？很简单，亚特兰大实在算不上什么强队，建队七十多年以来，唯一能拿得出手的荣誉就是在六十年代夺得了一次意大利杯的冠军，此外联赛中的最好成绩也不过是第五名，和北方三强相比，实在是有些拿不出手。
俱乐部唯一值得称道的也就是他们的青训营了，这些年来，一共为意大利各级球队贡献了多名球员，最早的有多纳多尼，此后又有多尼，现在的蒙托利沃更是在意大利U23岁以下青年队担任队长的职务。
所以这么多年以来，尽管亚特兰大实力不济，年年保级，偶尔做回升降梯，可是就连北方三强也不会忽视他们的存在，因为亚特兰大队中的那一批青年才俊，实在是很吸引人。
当然这里面并不包括迪甘。
今天因为是新赛季的第一场比赛，上座率还是十分喜人的，近百分之八十的看台都被坐满了，比赛还没开始，那些亚特兰大球迷就已经开始又唱又跳了。
即使迪甘坐在更衣室里，依然能听到外面球迷的欢呼声，这让他的身子不禁微微颤抖了起来。
帕齐尼就坐在迪甘的身边，见状用肩膀撞了迪甘一下，道：“嘿！罗德！你该不会是太紧张了吧！你这样子可别被教练看见，要不然的话，我想他是不会带着一个随时要尿裤子的小伙子上场的！”
迪甘转过头，对着帕齐尼露出了一个类似比克大魔王的笑，道：“詹保罗，想要让我在比赛的时候，朝着你的屁股射门吗？”
帕齐尼一听，刚才还咧着嘴笑，一下子就苦了，这两天他算是见识到迪甘的威力了，尤其是禁区外的大力射门，这要是集中他的屁股，别说菊花了，估计菊花台都保不住。
赶紧舔着脸讨好道：“得了！罗德！你知道我们是好搭档，不过你现在最好还是放松点儿的好。”
帕齐尼像个老前辈一样对着迪甘说道，估计连他自己都忘了，他也是个连一场意甲比赛都没参加过的鲜嫩小菜鸟一枚。
迪甘倚着墙面，道：“我知道，我现在很放松，非常放松！”
“放松的要打摆子！”
“滚粗！老子这是激动！”
迪甘正激动着，曼多利尼进来了，他的脸上带着笑，让每个人都能感觉到他强大的自信，只不过剥去那层自信的外衣，里面装着的确实忐忑不安的一颗心。
这同样也是他作为主教练带队打的第一场比赛，他希望能有一个好的开场，毕竟谁都不希望自己的第一台戏就唱砸了。
稳定了一下心神，曼多利尼开始了他的甲级球队主教练的第一次开场白：“都准备好了吗？小伙子们！我猜你们现在一定都迫不及待的想要上场去踢那只小辣椒的屁股了！”
迪甘忍住没讲这句嘈吐出来。
好在接下来曼多利尼没说什么为了亚特兰大的荣誉，为了亚特兰大球迷奋斗之类的大俗套话，现在谁还愿意听这些啊？

球员们踢球一是为了冠军，拿不到冠军的话就去追逐金钱，这个才是最实在的，球队的容易，干我屁事！
“在球场上发挥出百分之百的自己，对得起球队付给你们的每一个里拉，还有别忘了我就在场边，还记得我昨天的那句话吗？我的球队没有主力替补之分，谁的状态好，谁就上场，哪怕比赛才开始了一分钟，只要让我发现你们的注意力不集中的话，就等着去预备队报道吧！我说到做到！”
说到做到！
听着怎么像常胜附体了！不过常胜是谁？
曼多利尼的狠话虽然让人心下惴惴，不过很显然这些话要更加有效果，有了上场机会，才有可能争取荣誉，有了荣誉能获得更多金钱，更大的名气，有了更大的名气就能追求更大的荣誉，然后再获得更多的金钱，这是一个良性循环，不过前提是能有比赛的机会。
谁也不想在新赛季刚一开始的时候，就被主教练给惦记上。
“好了！去享受比赛吧！我希望等到比赛结束之后，我们能在蓝色意大利球场一起庆祝这场胜利！”
必杀令！
曼多利尼轻描淡写的就宣布了这场比赛的目标，可以想象要是赢不下莱切的话，他们要承受曼多利尼怎样的怒火。
到了出场的时候了，现场解说员已经拿到了双方的出场名单，先是做客蓝色意大利球场的莱切队，门将西奇尼亚诺，四后卫（从左往右）卡塞蒂、迪亚穆特内、斯托维尼、拉洛，中场吉亚科马奇、莱德斯玛、达拉博纳，三前锋科南、别拉诺维齐、皮纳尔迪。
亚特兰大队方面，门将泰比，四后卫（从左往右）贝利尼、萨拉、纳塔利、里瓦尔塔，中场后腰阿尔贝蒂尼，左边前卫泽诺尼，右边前卫马尔科利尼，组织型中场蒙托利沃，前锋帕齐尼，迪甘。
迪甘是谁？
所有人都在脑子里画了一个问号，即使是最资深的亚特兰大球迷也猜不到这个迪甘会是那个大咖。
不是上个赛季的主力前锋绍达蒂，也不是皮亚，不是老将科曼迪尼，也不是赛季开始前一致被看好的克罗地亚小子布丹，而是迪甘。
现场解说员显然也是刚拿到这份名单，赶紧翻阅亚特兰大队送来的资料，总算是找到了迪甘的那一份，忙照着念道：“罗德里格.伊泽森.桑托斯.莱特！租借自AC米兰，身高194公分，体重93公斤，在转会米兰之前，曾效力过巴西豪门圣保罗。”
AC米兰！
立刻就有消息灵通的球迷联想到了迪甘的来历，并且迅速在看台上传播开来。
“迪甘！就是卡卡的弟弟！？”
“就是那个在米兰热身赛的时候，出了大丑的那个蠢货！”
“上帝啊！我想科曼迪尼一定是疯了，那个迪甘不是踢后卫的吗？”

“我想科曼迪尼一定以为自己比安切洛蒂更加高明，能把一个蹩脚的后卫，调教成超级前锋！”
“那家伙就是个蠢蛋，俱乐部的人也都疯了，如果他们真的要把莱特家的人带来，为什么不是卡卡，而是这个迪甘，或许他们以为做哥哥的能成为球星，做弟弟的也一定差不了，真是一群蠢货！”
站在球员通道等着上场的迪甘一定没想到，他人还没登上球场，就已经名声在外了，当然都不是什么好名声，伴随着的都是蠢货，笨蛋之类的评价。
上场的时候到了，迪甘更加激动起来，距离上一次参加正式比赛是什么时候的事情了？
那还要追溯到他上辈子十七岁了，参加的最后一张比赛是对阵来访的谢菲尔德联青年队，那场比赛他贡献了两次助攻，还有三个进球，成为了当之无愧的明星，只可惜那场比赛之后，他就被检查出患有先天性心脏病，无奈的结束了自己的职业生涯。
现在一切推倒重来，他也是满心的期待。
走在最前面的是场上队长泰比，刚一露头，看台上立刻便响起了一阵欢呼声，紧接着出场的蒙托利沃，萨拉，贝利尼，纳塔利都是一样，到迪甘了。
他甚至都举起了双臂，准备迎接欢呼声，但是当现场解说员喊出他名字的时候，却是一片死一样的宁静，紧接着就是如同海啸般的嘘声，将面带笑容的迪甘一下子吹到了大西洋，脸上的笑容也瞬间凝固了。
站在迪甘身后的帕齐尼先是一阵错愕，紧接着就感觉到了浓浓的杀气。
教练席上的曼多利尼脸色更是难看的要杀人：一群混蛋！你们错过了亚特兰大历史上最伟大的球员。
迪甘看着看台上那些发了疯一样将嘘声抛过来的球迷，突然笑了。
打脸吗？
那就要有被打的觉悟！
content_en:
Chapter 13 Who is that boy?
The Stadio Azul Italia, the home stadium of Atalanta Football Team, can accommodate more than 25,000 people at the same time. In the past, the attendance rate here was not high. Why? Quite simply, Atalanta is not really a strong team. In the more than 70 years since the team was founded, the only honor it can win is winning the Italian Cup in the 1960s. In addition, the best result in the league is only fifth place. Compared with the top three in the north, it is really a bit unachievable.
The only thing the club deserves praise for is their youth training camp. Over the years, they have contributed many players to Italian teams at all levels. The first was Donadoni, and then Doni. Now Montolivo is the captain of the Italian U23 youth team.
So for so many years, even though Atlanta has been weak, relegated every year, and occasionally promoted and relegated, even the top three in the North will not ignore their existence, because the group of young talents in the Atlanta team are really attractive.
Of course, this does not include Deegan.
Because today is the first game of the new season, the attendance rate is still very gratifying. Nearly 80% of the stands are full. The Atlanta fans have already started singing and dancing before the game starts.
Even though Deegan was sitting in the locker room, he could still hear the cheers of the fans outside, which made his body tremble slightly.
Pazzini was sitting next to Deegan. When he saw this, he bumped Deegan with his shoulder and said: "Hey! Rod! You must be too nervous! Don't let the coach see you like this, otherwise, I don't think he will bring a young man on the field who is ready to pee his pants at any time!"
Deegan turned his head and faced Pazzini with a smile similar to that of Piccolo, and said: "Giampaolo, do you want me to shoot your ass during the game?"
When Pazzini heard this, he was grinning just now and suddenly felt miserable. In the past two days, he had seen the power of Deegan, especially the powerful shots from outside the penalty area. If this concentrated his buttocks, let alone the anus, he probably wouldn't be able to save the anus.
He quickly licked his face to please him and said, "Come on! Rod! You know we are good partners, but you'd better relax now."
Pazzini said to Deegan like an old-timer, probably even he has forgotten that he is also a young rookie who has never participated in a Serie A game.
Deegan leaned against the wall and said, "I know, I'm very relaxed now, very relaxed!"
"Relax and show off!"
"Get out of here! I'm so excited!"
Deegan was excited when Mandolini came in with a smile on his face, letting everyone feel his strong self-confidence. However, after peeling off the outer layer of self-confidence, there was indeed an uneasy heart inside.
This is also his first game as a head coach. He hopes to have a good start. After all, no one wants to fail in their first performance.
After calming down, Mandolini began his first opening remarks as the head coach of a first-division team: "Are you ready? Boys! I guess you all can't wait to go out and kick that little pepper's ass now!"
Deegan restrained himself from saying this.
Fortunately, Mandolini didn't say any clichés about fighting for the honor of Atlanta and fighting for the fans of Atlanta. Who is willing to listen to this now?
Players play football for the championship. If they don't win the championship, they will chase money. This is the most real thing. It's easy for the team, so do my shit!
"Perform 100% of yourself on the court and be worthy of every lira the team pays you. And don't forget that I am on the sidelines. Do you still remember what I said yesterday? There is no main substitute in my team. Whose?Whoever is in good condition will play. Even if the game has only started for one minute, if I notice that you are not paying attention, just wait to report to the reserve team! I do what I say! "
Do what you say!
It sounds like Chang Sheng is possessed! But who is Chang Sheng?
Although Mandolini's cruel words make people feel anxious, it is obvious that these words must be more effective. With the opportunity to play, it is possible to strive for honors. With honors, you can get more money and greater fame. With greater fame, you can pursue greater honors, and then get more money. This is a virtuous circle, but the premise is that there is a chance to compete.
No one wants to be worried about the head coach at the beginning of the new season.
"Okay! Go enjoy the game! I hope that after the game is over, we can celebrate this victory together at the Stadio Azul Italia! "
Kill order!
Mandolini announced the goal of this game in an understatement. You can imagine how much anger they will have to bear if they fail to win against Lecce.
When it's time to play, the on-site commentator has already got the playing list of both sides. First, the Lecce team is a guest at the Blue Italia Stadium. Goalkeeper Ciccignano, four defenders (from left to right) Cassetti, Diamutone, Stovini, and Lalo, midfielders Giacomachi, Ledesma, and Darabona, and three forwards Conan, Belanovich, and Pinardi.
As for the Atlanta team, goalkeeper Taibbi, four defenders (from left to right) Bellini, Sala, Natali, Rivalta, midfielder Albertini, left midfielder Zenoni, right midfielder Marcolini, organizational midfielder Montolivo, forward Pazzini, Deegan.
Who is Deegan?
Everyone has a question mark in their mind. Even the most senior Atlanta fans can't guess that this Deegan will be the big shot.
It's not last season's main forward Saudati, nor Pia, nor veteran Komandini, nor Boudin, the Croatian boy who was unanimously optimistic before the start of the season, but Deegan.
The on-site commentator obviously just got this list, and quickly looked through the information sent by the Atlanta team, and finally found Deegan's copy, and hurriedly read it: "Rodrigo Izerson Santos Wright! On loan from AC Milan, he is 194 centimeters tall and weighs 93 kilograms. Before moving to Milan, he played for the Brazilian giant Sao Paulo. "
AC Milan!
Immediately, well-informed fans made the connection to Deegan's origins, and word quickly spread in the stands.
“Deegan! He's Kaka's younger brother! ? "
"It's the idiot who made a big fool of himself during the warm-up match in Milan! "
"Oh God! I think Comandini must be crazy. Isn't that Deegan playing as a defender? "
"I think Comandini must think that he is better than Ancelotti and can turn a poor defender into a super striker! "
"That guy is an idiot, and everyone in the club is crazy. If they really want to bring the Wright family, why not Kaka, but this Deegan? Maybe they thought that if the older brother can become a star, then the younger brother will be the same. What a bunch of idiots! "
Deegan, who was standing in the tunnel waiting to play, must not have expected that others would already be famous before they even stepped on the court. Of course, they were not good reputations, and they were accompanied by comments such as idiots and idiots.
When it was time to play, Deegan became even more excited. When was the last time he participated in an official game?
That goes back to when he was seventeen years old in his previous life. The last game he participated in was against the visiting Sheffield United youth team. In that game, he contributed two assists and three goals, becoming a well-deserved star. Unfortunately, after that game, he was diagnosed with congenital heart disease and ended his life helplessly.own career.
Now that everything has been overturned, he is full of expectations.
The one who walked at the front was captain Taibbi. As soon as he showed his head, a burst of cheers erupted in the stands, followed by Montolivo, Sala, Bellini, and Natalie, all of whom arrived in Deegan.
He even raised his arms, ready to welcome the cheers, but when the on-site commentator called out his name, there was a deathly silence, followed by boos like a tsunami, which blew the smiling Deegan to the Atlantic Ocean, and the smile on his face froze in an instant.
Pazzini, who was standing behind Degan, was stunned for a while, and then felt a strong murderous aura.
Mandolini's expression on the coaching bench was even more ugly: a bunch of bastards! You guys are missing out on the greatest player in Atlanta history.
Deegan looked at the fans in the stands who were booing like crazy and suddenly smiled.
A slap in the face?
Then you have to be prepared to be beaten!
